prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-quality GAME SCREEN ART DIRECTION candidate for Chinese single-player pixel RPG 来自月亮的Z. The player is watching a VTuber's livestream through a SMARTPHONE, as a remote viewer. The content is a rendered front-facing video broadcast, not an overhead game room. Reference1 is Z identity ONLY: an ADULT beautiful ethereal woman, silver-white long hair, crescent hair clip, mist-blue eyes, ivory cardigan, flowing pale ice-blue dress and navy waist ribbon; composed cool exterior with a subtle warm smile. Reference2 is palette/pixel material reference ONLY, do NOT reuse its isometric composition, RPG dialogue box or tiny character. Draw Z as a large detailed waist-up front-facing broadcast avatar, layered 2D animation / Live2D-like illustration with clear pixel edges and clustered shading compatible with the game's existing art. Gentle head tilt, speaking mouth slightly open, hand lightly raised. Elegant not childish, not photorealistic, not 3D. Show her face large enough to read expression. Broadcast camera at eye level; she looks towards the viewer or chat. Background is her broadcast backdrop: subdued moonlit sea window, soft warm desk lamp, indistinct microphone edge, no written wall signs. Rich dark charcoal, muted navy, cream, desaturated sea-green, restrained brass-gold; warm ivory and ice blue hair. No neon purple, no glossy modern gradients, no web dashboard cards, no physical environmental paragraphs.
All visible text clean simplified Chinese with generous padding. Show red live dot '直播中', channel 'Z', small topic '今晚，聊聊岛上的声音', viewer count '1,286', game-phone time '20:10', wallet '金币 74'. No 精力, no 岛券, no energy/lightning/stamina bar, no heart relationship progress bar, no recharge/real-money shop, no giant chapter/timer HUD. The screen must have chat from several viewers, a sent message by player '听潮：能把码头铃声做成开场节拍吗？', a small active reply caption 'Z：听潮，这个点子不错。', an editable composer draft '先敲两下，再接海浪声。' and a '发送' button. Gift action '礼物' with present icon; optional small event '阿树 送出 星星瓶 ×1' clearly another viewer. Voluntary random-call action '报名连麦', compact status '随机连麦 · 开放报名', no fake promise the player is selected, no numeric probability. Clearly separate viewer chat from Z's live subtitles. Avoid huge RPG bottom dialogue boxes and repeated portrait avatars of Z. All interaction is within the smartphone app; no floating physical avatars outside screen. No annotation arrows, art direction labels A/B/C, watermarks, explanatory footnotes, or device brand names.
ART DIRECTION A: warm brass and charcoal LANDSCAPE PHONE with separate chat column. Canvas wide 16:9, one single screen, not a contact sheet. Show a thin dark pixel-art landscape smartphone bezel occupying about 94% of canvas on an understated almost black backdrop, with subtle speaker notch on left edge. All app content is INSIDE the landscape screen. App top bar thin. The video takes left 70% with Z waist-up centered in it, her head about30% video height. Right 30% is a slim dark chat column with 4–5 readable messages and subtle gold accent on player's row; small gold gift event under chat. Player composer spans lower width under video/chat, gift and call buttons clearly separate to the right, coin wallet at far corner. Small red '直播中' and online count feel like actual streaming UI. Pixel bevels, thin aged brass separators, matte dark backgrounds, sparse ornament from the existing CRPG UI. Face dominates video, room stays subtle background. Chat readable at normal PC resolution. Natural usable phone streaming app, polished restrained interface.

Lower-left over the video has exactly three compact dark translucent chat lines with cream text, leave face completely unobstructed. Active Z reply subtitle in one slim caption line below her face. Bottom about25% is an ivory lightly textured panel with small sea-green borders: random call status, then composer and send, then a clean row '礼物' and '报名连麦' with tiny pixel icons, wallet '金币 74'. refinements.prompt: Edit ONLY these two tiny textual details in the reference screenshot. Keep all framing, smartphone shape, every interface element, exact white-haired Z identity and expression, her front-facing livestream pose, colors and typography unchanged. 1. In the third spectator chat line, replace '咸鱼也发光：好期待游戏上线！' with exactly '咸鱼也发光：想听听码头的声音。' because this is in-world chat, not a promotional game comment. 2. Add a very small understated '20:10' phone clock immediately left of the top-right '金币 74' wallet with comfortable padding, without shifting any element. Retain gold balance74, Z reply, draft input, gift buttons and call status unchanged. All phone content is remote video, not an overhead room. Change nothing else.
